label: Current-State Interview Guide
clientPurpose: Run structured interviews to capture how the work happens today and where it breaks.
recommendedAudience: Business sponsor; Legal Operations Lead; Business process owner
supportedBuildingBlocks: Process redesign; Human-in-the-loop agent; Controls / governance / risk model
requiredSections: How work enters and is triaged; Where work waits and gets approved; Exceptions and escalations
sampleQuestions: Where does a request enter? | Who approves, and when? | Where do exceptions happen?
lakeshore_legal_example: Contract requests arrive by email, form, and shared folder; triage is manual and inconsistent.

label: Process Walkthrough Template
clientPurpose: Map the end-to-end current-state workflow with handoffs and cycle time.
recommendedAudience: Business process owner; Legal Operations Lead
supportedBuildingBlocks: Process redesign; Workflow automation
requiredSections: Workflow stages and handoffs; Cycle time and queue points
sampleQuestions: What are the stages from intake to close? | Where does work queue and age?
lakeshore_legal_example: Average review cycle time is 31.6 days with a P90 of 52 days.

label: Systems and Data Inventory Template
clientPurpose: Inventory the systems and data involved, and identify the system of record.
supportedBuildingBlocks: Data readiness / remediation; System / platform implementation
requiredSections: Systems in scope; Required data fields and gaps; Source of truth and ownership
sampleQuestions: Which fields are missing? | Which system is the source of truth? | Who owns data quality?
lakeshore_legal_example: 81.5% of requests arrive missing at least one required intake field; obligation ownership is unreliable.

label: Pain-Point and Root-Cause Workshop Summary
clientPurpose: Synthesize pain points into root-cause candidates the solution must address.
recommendedAudience: Business sponsor; Legal Operations Lead; Business process owner
supportedBuildingBlocks: Process redesign; Data readiness / remediation; Human-in-the-loop agent
requiredSections: Pain points by stage; Root-cause candidates; Open questions
sampleQuestions: What is the real root cause, not the symptom? | What is out of scope?
lakeshore_legal_example: Root cause is incomplete intake and inconsistent triage — not attorney capacity.

label: Business Appetite for Change Template
clientPurpose: Capture how much change and disruption the business is ready to absorb.
supportedBuildingBlocks: Process redesign; Value tracking / operating cadence
requiredSections: Appetite for workflow disruption; Value expectations and proof bar
sampleQuestions: How much change can the team absorb in phase one? | What proof do you need before scaling?
lakeshore_legal_example: Phase one should minimize workflow disruption; hard savings require finance attestation.

label: Current-State Final Review Template
clientPurpose: The client-reviewed, confirmed current-state view that P3 designs against.
supportedBuildingBlocks: Process redesign; Data readiness / remediation; Controls / governance / risk model; Value tracking / operating cadence
requiredSections: Confirmed current-state truth; Confirmed baselines; Confirmed control boundaries
sampleQuestions: Do we agree on what is happening today and what is broken?
lakeshore_legal_example: Client-confirmed: intake quality and handoffs are the constraint; attorney approval stays for non-standard terms.

label: Solution Options Canvas
clientPurpose: Lay out 2–3 realistic solution options before committing to architecture.
recommendedAudience: Business sponsor; IT / CLM owner; Legal Operations Lead
supportedBuildingBlocks: Process redesign; AI-assisted decision support; Workflow automation; System / platform implementation
requiredSections: Option definitions; Fit to current-state findings
sampleQuestions: What are the practical options? | Which is realistic for phase one?
lakeshore_legal_example: A: process-first cleanup · B: CLM-embedded assisted triage & obligation extraction · C: cross-system orchestration layer.

label: Pros / Cons and Tradeoff Matrix
clientPurpose: Compare options on value, risk, readiness, and effort.
recommendedAudience: Business sponsor; Finance / value owner; IT / CLM owner
supportedBuildingBlocks: AI-assisted decision support; Controls / governance / risk model; Value tracking / operating cadence
requiredSections: Tradeoffs by option; Readiness impact
sampleQuestions: What do we accept and give up with each option?
lakeshore_legal_example: Option B balances speed, adoption, control, and measurable value; C is high integration risk before baseline proof.

label: Human + AI Work Split Template
clientPurpose: Define exactly what AI does versus what humans decide and approve.
recommendedAudience: Legal Operations Lead; Legal / compliance reviewer
supportedBuildingBlocks: Human-in-the-loop agent; AI-assisted decision support; Controls / governance / risk model
requiredSections: What AI recommends; Where humans approve
sampleQuestions: What can AI do alone? | Where must a human approve?
lakeshore_legal_example: AI suggests risk tier and missing info; attorney approves non-standard terms. No autonomous approval.

label: Architecture Constraints Template
clientPurpose: Capture the constraints the target architecture must respect.
supportedBuildingBlocks: System / platform implementation; Controls / governance / risk model; Data readiness / remediation
requiredSections: Systems and integration constraints; Security / privilege constraints
sampleQuestions: Can the current platform support this? | What must be fenced?
lakeshore_legal_example: Embed in the existing CLM; preserve privilege and privacy boundaries; no new platform in phase one.

label: Controls and Guardrails Checklist
clientPurpose: Confirm the control boundaries and guardrails the design must enforce.
supportedBuildingBlocks: Controls / governance / risk model; Human-in-the-loop agent
requiredSections: Approval boundaries; Audit and privacy requirements
sampleQuestions: What must be approved? | What must be logged? | What cannot be automated?
lakeshore_legal_example: Attorney approval required; full audit trail; privilege fence; no autonomous legal decisions.

label: Solution Approach Decision Summary
clientPurpose: The client-reviewed decision: chosen approach, rationale, and what is deferred.
recommendedAudience: Business sponsor; Legal Operations Lead; Finance / value owner
supportedBuildingBlocks: AI-assisted decision support; Human-in-the-loop agent; Controls / governance / risk model; Workflow automation
requiredSections: Selected solution approach; Rejected / deferred options; Human + AI split and controls
sampleQuestions: Which solution approach should we use, and why?
lakeshore_legal_example: Selected Option B (CLM-embedded assisted triage & obligation extraction). Deferred: autonomous review, orchestration layer.

label: Roadmap Workstream Template
clientPurpose: Convert the approved approach into sequenced workstreams.
recommendedAudience: Business sponsor; IT / CLM owner; Legal Operations Lead
supportedBuildingBlocks: Process redesign; Data readiness / remediation; Workflow automation; Human-in-the-loop agent; Controls / governance / risk model; Value tracking / operating cadence
requiredSections: Workstreams by lane; Dependencies and sequence
sampleQuestions: What are the workstreams and their order?
lakeshore_legal_example: Intake redesign · metadata remediation · CLM routing config · AI-assisted triage · controls · Tower metrics.

label: Cost and Effort Assumptions Template
clientPurpose: Capture cost/effort assumptions per workstream for the business case.
recommendedAudience: Finance / value owner; IT / CLM owner
supportedBuildingBlocks: System / platform implementation; Value tracking / operating cadence
requiredSections: Effort by workstream; Delivery model options
sampleQuestions: What is the phase-one cost range and delivery model?
lakeshore_legal_example: Boutique-led hybrid $0.95–1.45M vs Big 4 $1.8–2.8M vs offshore-heavy $0.62–0.98M (control/adoption risk).

label: Value Assumptions Review Template
clientPurpose: Validate value assumptions with finance and separate directional from hard value.
supportedBuildingBlocks: Value tracking / operating cadence; Controls / governance / risk model
requiredSections: Value levers and proof level; Directional vs hard value
sampleQuestions: Which value is directional and which is hard? | What must finance attest?
lakeshore_legal_example: 8–12% cycle-time improvement (operational); hard dollar savings require finance evidence.

label: Risk and Readiness Register
clientPurpose: Record risks and readiness gaps that gate the plan.
recommendedAudience: IT / CLM owner; Legal / compliance reviewer
supportedBuildingBlocks: Controls / governance / risk model; Data readiness / remediation
requiredSections: Risks and mitigations; Readiness gaps
sampleQuestions: What must be true before we start? | What could go wrong?
lakeshore_legal_example: Integration/privilege controls; requestor adoption; finance proof for hard savings.

label: Tower Metrics Definition Template
clientPurpose: Define the metrics Tower will track, with baselines and targets.
supportedBuildingBlocks: Value tracking / operating cadence
requiredSections: Metric definitions and baselines
sampleQuestions: What metric proves value? | What is baseline and target?
lakeshore_legal_example: Cycle time, intake completeness, aged queue, obligation capture, status inquiries.

label: Finance / Sponsor Review Summary
clientPurpose: The client-reviewed plan approval: what will be funded and how value is measured.
supportedBuildingBlocks: Value tracking / operating cadence; Controls / governance / risk model
requiredSections: Approved roadmap and funding; Approved measurement plan
sampleQuestions: What will we fund, when, and how will value be measured?
lakeshore_legal_example: Approved 12-week boutique-led hybrid; Tower measures cycle time and obligation capture.

label: RACI and Ownership Template
clientPurpose: Assign an accountable owner to every workstream and lane.
recommendedAudience: Business sponsor; IT / CLM owner; Legal Operations Lead
supportedBuildingBlocks: Process redesign; Data readiness / remediation; Workflow automation; Controls / governance / risk model; Value tracking / operating cadence
requiredSections: Owner per workstream; Approvers and reviewers
sampleQuestions: Who owns what? | Who approves?
lakeshore_legal_example: Legal Ops → process; Data owner → remediation; IT → CLM; Legal → control approval; Tower owner → measurement.

label: Launch Readiness Checklist
clientPurpose: Confirm the move is ready to start.
recommendedAudience: IT / CLM owner; Legal / compliance reviewer
supportedBuildingBlocks: System / platform implementation; Controls / governance / risk model
requiredSections: Readiness items and status
sampleQuestions: Are we ready to start? | What is still open?
lakeshore_legal_example: Obligation-owner matrix, controls, requestor training, and value metrics ready before mobilization.

label: Training and Change Plan Template
clientPurpose: Plan the training and change management for adoption.
supportedBuildingBlocks: Process redesign; Human-in-the-loop agent
requiredSections: Training plan by role; Change and adoption approach
sampleQuestions: Who needs training? | How will we drive adoption?
lakeshore_legal_example: Requestor guidance on complete intake; reviewer training on the confirmation step.

label: Approval Conditions Template
clientPurpose: Capture the conditions and approvals required to proceed.
supportedBuildingBlocks: Controls / governance / risk model
requiredSections: Approval path and conditions
sampleQuestions: What approvals are needed to start?
lakeshore_legal_example: Sponsor endorsement + Legal control sign-off; conditions on privilege handling.

label: Execution Handoff Review Summary
clientPurpose: The client-reviewed mobilization plan handed to delivery and Tower.
supportedBuildingBlocks: Process redesign; Controls / governance / risk model; Value tracking / operating cadence
requiredSections: Confirmed owners and approvals; Confirmed measurement handoff
sampleQuestions: Who owns what, and are we ready to start?
lakeshore_legal_example: Owners confirmed; Tower measurement contract accepted; ready to mobilize.

label: Measurement Contract Template
clientPurpose: The agreed contract of what Tower measures and how value is proven.
supportedBuildingBlocks: Value tracking / operating cadence; Controls / governance / risk model
requiredSections: Metric, baseline, target, formula
sampleQuestions: How will we know this worked?
lakeshore_legal_example: Cycle time and obligation capture with baselines, targets, owners, and cadence.

label: Metric Owner Matrix
clientPurpose: Assign an accountable owner to each Tower metric.
supportedBuildingBlocks: Value tracking / operating cadence
requiredSections: Metric to owner
sampleQuestions: Who owns each metric?
lakeshore_legal_example: Legal Ops owns cycle time; Data owner owns intake completeness; Finance owns hard-value attestation.

label: Outcome Review Cadence Template
clientPurpose: Set the operating cadence for reviewing outcomes.
supportedBuildingBlocks: Value tracking / operating cadence
requiredSections: Cadence and participants
sampleQuestions: How often do we review, and with whom?
lakeshore_legal_example: Monthly value review with Legal Ops, Finance, and the sponsor.

label: Escalation Threshold Template
clientPurpose: Define the thresholds that trigger escalation when value does not show up.
supportedBuildingBlocks: Value tracking / operating cadence; Controls / governance / risk model
requiredSections: Thresholds and escalation path
sampleQuestions: What if value does not show up?
lakeshore_legal_example: Escalate if cycle time does not improve within two review cycles.

label: Value Realization Review Template
clientPurpose: Track realized value against the projection over time.
supportedBuildingBlocks: Value tracking / operating cadence
requiredSections: Realized vs projected value
sampleQuestions: What value did we actually realize?
lakeshore_legal_example: Realized cycle-time reduction and obligation capture vs the P4 projection.
